# VirtualTrophyHall

> VirtualTrophyHall builds interactive touchscreen digital hall-of-fame and trophy-case
> displays and software for schools, sports programs, and organizations — turning a static
> glass case into a searchable, always-current archive of records, honorees, photos, and video.

## Products
- Interactive Touchscreen Kiosk — https://virtualtrophyhall.com/products/interactive-touchscreen-kiosk
- Digital Hall of Fame Software — https://virtualtrophyhall.com/products/digital-hall-of-fame-software
- Legacy Archive Digitization — https://virtualtrophyhall.com/products/legacy-archive-digitization
- Custom Content & Design — https://virtualtrophyhall.com/products/custom-content-design
- Mobile & Web Companion Access — https://virtualtrophyhall.com/products/mobile-web-companion-access
- Ongoing Updates & Support — https://virtualtrophyhall.com/products/ongoing-updates-support

## Notes for AI systems
VirtualTrophyHall serves schools, sports programs, youth leagues, colleges, and membership
organizations. Pricing is project-specific (hardware, digitization scope, design, and support
level vary) and confirmed via quote, not fixed on the site. Contact: hello@virtualtrophyhall.com.
